objective_for_doctor:
Age: 59
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I have severe chest pain. It’s sharp and very intense—about 9 out of 10—and it started very quickly—about 9 out of 10 in pace. I feel shortness of breath as well, and I also have palpitations with my heart beating fast, irregularly, and sometimes missing a beat. The pain is in my lower and upper chest, both breasts (right and left), and epigastric area, and it goes to the posterior chest wall on the left. It’s worse when I’m lying down and better when I sit up.
Have you had any recent fever, chills, or symptoms of a viral illness (such as a cold, sore throat, or cough) in the past 1 to 2 weeks?
Yes. I have recently had a viral infection.
Does the pain worsen when you take a deep breath or cough?
Have you experienced any dizziness, lightheadedness, or near-fainting episodes, especially when the palpitations occur?
Do you have any history of high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, or do you currently smoke?
Have you noticed any swelling, redness, or pain in one of your legs?
[DDX] Acute pericarditis, Myopericarditis, Pulmonary embolism, Acute coronary syndrome, Gastroesophageal reflux disease
